extDescription.message: Select text on any page, right-click, and read it in German at your level. Then practice with exercises built from it.

commandTranslate.message: Translate the selected text to German

popupHowto.message: Select text on any page, right-click it and choose $1.

popupNoShortcut.message: No keyboard shortcut set. Add one at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

pairingInstruction.message: Match each German word to its Russian meaning.

pairingHint.message: Choose a German word on the left first.

dictationInstruction.message: Listen and type the whole sentence.

reportTitle.message: Sends this paragraph and its German translation for review

noticeOffline.message: You're offline. Text you've translated before still works; new text needs a connection.

noticeUnavailable.message: The translation service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.

noticeLimit.message: Today's translation limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.

noticeTextTooLong.message: This text is too long to translate at once. Select at most $1 characters.

noticeFailed.message: Couldn't translate this text. Select it and try again.

noticeSelectFirst.message: Select the text you want to translate first.

noticeEditable.message: Sprachweise doesn't translate text you're typing.

noticeExcluded.message: Selection includes code or form fields — select plain text only.

noticeMixed.message: Selection includes text outside a paragraph — select text inside paragraphs only.

noticeSelectionTooLong.message: The selection is too long ($1 characters). Select at most $2 characters — about five paragraphs — at a time.

noticePageChanged.message: The page changed while translating. Select the text again.

progressQueueEmpty.message: Nothing scheduled yet — answer an exercise to start building your review queue.

settingsNote.message: Changes apply to text translated after you save — text already translated on the page keeps its current version.

reviewNothingDue.message: Nothing is due today. Come back tomorrow.
